_provisional_why: FALSE as of 3 Aug 2026. Every manipulated pool is now Mengkai's final value:
hue and saturation 30 Jul, roughness and material type 3 Aug, illuminance 3 Aug.
Nothing in this file is a placeholder any more.

hue: 10 Munsell-calibrated categories, NOT an even 36 or 30 degree step. Adopted from
the Munsell-to-HSV mapping in Febbraio et al. (2025). Note the gaps: 150 (between
G and BG) and 210 (between BG and B) are deliberately absent. Do not 'tidy' them.
Warm/cool valence split per Song et al. (2025).
STILL TO MODEL: black and white achromatic anchors. They are in her pool but
cannot be expressed as a hue degree, so they need a schema decision -- see README.
saturation: FINAL, 30 Jul 2026 -- same diagram, dimension 2. Two fixed points, 20% and 40%.
Both sit inside the ecological ceiling: Yi and Kang (2020) found 92% of real
surfaces below 35% saturation. Levels taken from two of the four tested by Wang
brightness: FINAL, 3 Aug 2026 (Mengkai). Four illuminance levels in LUX: 150, 300, 500, 750.
ONE POOL FOR ALL FOUR EMOTIONS, not a per-emotion range. That is a change of kind,
not just of value: the earlier design had a band per emotion, so a scene's lux could
be checked against what its target emotion called for. With a single shared pool
there is no per-emotion expectation to check against, so the illuminance
manipulation check no longer has anything to test.
texture: Chosen to differ in surface STRUCTURE while staying neutral in hue, so material type
stays orthogonal to the hue manipulation. Wood, brick and marble were rejected for
the manipulated dimension because their own strong colour would fight the hue
variable rather than vary alongside it. Albedo maps must stay greyscale.
roughness: FINAL, 3 Aug 2026 (Mengkai). Two levels: rough and smooth.
Now REQUIRED, not optional -- roughness_required is true above. Her config must
carry the field and a config without it no longer validates.
Rendering: both levels share metallic 0 and the same specular response, differing
only in microsurface. Her 10 Jul note flags that gloss must be controlled so it does
not confound with roughness; letting specular move with smoothness would be exactly
that confound. Unity smoothness values in roughness_levels below.

_researcher_set_notes.shapes: Between-subjects, one per participant. Never an LLM output, never in the pool.
wall_value: Wall HSV *value*, fixed at 100% per her diagram, dimension 3. Was 0.85 here.
Her two reasons are sound and worth not re-litigating: fixing V avoids a
hue-value confound (she computed the brightest-to-darkest hue luminance ratio as
1.21x at S=20% and 1.54x at S=40%, set by saturation and not by V), and it
decouples wall colour from scene lighting so all perceived luminance variation
comes from the lux variable.
OPEN, and an engineering point rather than a disagreement with any of that:
HSV V=100% is a colour-space specification. Used directly as a Unity albedo it is
a reflectance near 1.0, which no real diffuse surface reaches (~0.85 is a white
painted wall). Two consequences at the top of the lux range, which is where the
excited and tense rooms live: bounce lighting gains energy it should not have,
and the wall clips toward white, weakening the hue manipulation exactly in the
conditions that depend on it.
The fix does not touch her design. Scaling albedo uniformly preserves every
ratio her argument rests on, because those ratios are scale-invariant. So V=1.0
can stay the specification while the renderer applies it at ~0.85. Needs one
in-headset check at the highest illuminance before it is settled either way.
She has separately flagged a related limitation herself: white scored highest on
pleasure in Febbraio et al. (2025), so a maximal value may work against the
negative-valence conditions.

_emotions_note: The four diagonal quadrants of Russell's circumplex, named by Mengkai (scene brief section 1). Note 'depressed', not 'sad'.

_comment: ALL NULL as of 3 Aug 2026. Illuminance is one shared pool of four levels rather
than a band per emotion, so no emotion has a literature-derived range to check a
scene against.
Null means 'no locked range': check_illuminance reports that status rather than a
pass or fail, and manipulation_check counts those separately from misses. The
machinery stays because it costs nothing and per-emotion bands may return; it
simply has nothing to assert right now.
Worth stating in the write-up: illuminance now has no manipulation check. Whether
the model picked a lux level appropriate to its target is a question the design
can no longer answer, because no level is designated appropriate to any emotion.
ENGINEERING DEFAULT, NOT literature-derived. Unity smoothness, 0 fully matte to 1
mirror. Not yet a manipulated pool variable -- see the texture note.
Both levels deliberately share metallic 0 and the same specular response, differing
only in microsurface. Her 10 Jul note flags that gloss must be controlled so it does
not confound with roughness, and letting specular move with smoothness would be
exactly that confound.
Verify in the headset: perceived roughness at 2 m under 30 lx is not what it looks
like on a monitor at desk brightness.
FINAL, 3 Aug 2026 (Mengkai). Medoid selection over the N samples per cell: keep the
single real sample closest to the middle of the batch, so the result is always one
of the model's actual outputs and never a per-variable blend. Satisfies the
constraint she set on 31 Jul by construction. Implemented in pipeline/aggregate.py.
aggregation._weights_note: Equal across the five fields; no literature basis to weight one over another.
